'B Plan' kept: ACE3-original codename with no official English; 'Project B' needs the missing j glyph and 'Plan B' would read as the English idiom for a fallback. Speaker (someone formerly with the New Federation) left unidentified; the line is speaker-neutral.
Berkt is male in character_names_021, so 'him' is supported; 'he's the one with the details' = Hayato, matching the source's familiar 'that guy has the detailed information'.

'The priest everyone's after' for the sought-after priest: the source does not say whose objective; both sides are in fact after the priest (1942 enemy order, 2013 rescue), so the wording does not mislead. Vehicle left as 'that' as in the source.
Follows the Gain/Gainer exchange 2019-2020, so the shout is most likely Gainer's. Bare organisation name plus a pejorative particle; 'Damn Siberian Railway!!' is a fair reading. Kept.

2002-2003 Yassaba facing an unfamiliar machine; replies neutral. Correct.
Eureka/Renton versus Yassaba: 'A child...?!' and the stay-calm advice are correct; the 2010-2011 speaker is not named in the English.

uncertainties.issue: Fix restores the causative. Subject left out as in the source, although 2013 ('Gain here') makes Gain the agent.

'This might work...' expands a bare 'with this...'; the shout could also be exasperation rather than an attack cry. Left as drafted.
'everyone's after' smooths an ownerless 'sought-after'; the alternative 'the priest we came for' would assign it to the Gekkostate side.
